title: Queues: First In, First Out
lead: A queue keeps items in order: the first item added is the first item removed, like people waiting in a line.

sections.heading: Enqueue and dequeue
sections.body: Add an item at the back with enqueue and remove one from the front with dequeue. With a suitable queue implementation, both operations can be O(1).

sections.heading: Where queues help
sections.body: Task scheduling, print jobs, message processing, and breadth-first search all use the idea of handling work in arrival order.

tryThis: Write a queue with A, B, and C. Dequeue them one at a time. Which value leaves first?
